subject: CAIQ: Proof chronicle, witness statements, and sampling window
messages:
From: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@ledgerone.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: LedgerOne Security Team <security@ledgerone.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ evidence request: witness statements + sampling window

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of our CAIQ review (CSA CCM v4.0) we need a curated set of artifacts and short witness statements for the controls listed below. The auditor (Tom Ellis from AuditBridge) needs: a recorded proof path for the control (where logs/artifacts live), a one-paragraph witness statement from the control owner describing how the control is implemented and monitored, and any redaction guidance applied to logs.

Controls in-scope (prioritized): CCM-LOG-03 (Audit logging capture), CCM-IDENT-02 (Key rotation / KMS), CCM-DATA-01 (Data classification / masking).

Sampling window: Q1-Q2 2027 (we want representative log snapshots and at least one retention sample).

Do you have an internal owner list and a suggested extraction path (S3 paths, runbook IDs, or console links)? We also prefer DocuSign for final owner attestations. Attached is our request package (LedgerOne-CAIQ-Request-20270314.pdf) for your reference.

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday (3/17) whether this is feasible and who the owners will be?

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Romero
Security Programs Lead, LedgerOne Financial

Attachments: LedgerOne-CAIQ-Request-20270314.pdf
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@ledgerone.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@auditbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence request: witness statements + sampling window

Thanks Alicia — appreciate the clear ask and the attachment.

High-level plan (quick):
- Create a "proof chronicle" that maps each CAIQ question to the artifact(s) and the canonical storage path (S3/Drive), plus a one-paragraph witness statement per control owner.
- Use a lightweight witness template for consistency (attached: witness_statement_template.docx).
- For logs we will extract time-bounded samples for Q1 and Q2 2027 and store them under a scoped, redacted path. We will document redaction steps in a short MD file (redaction_guidelines.md).

Ownership proposal (subject to Neha/Jordan confirmation):
- CCM-LOG-03 (Audit logging): neha_kapoor (owner) — will provide S3 prefix and CloudTrail/OS logs mapping.
- CCM-IDENT-02 (KMS/keys): jordan_blake (owner) — will provide key rotation records and KMS activity logs.
- CCM-DATA-01 (Data classification): tessa_morgan (owner) — will provide classification matrix and masking rules.

DocuSign: we can prepare attestations and route to owners once witness statements are populated.

I will create the proof chronicle folder and share a link (internal drive) by EOD tomorrow so your team can start consuming artifacts. Can you confirm AuditBridge's preferred file formats for log snapshots (CSV vs. gzip JSON)?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Trust Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: witness_statement_template.docx
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@ledgerone.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@auditbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence request: witness statements + sampling window

Looping in with a few clarifications from my side.

1) Log snapshot format: AuditBridge prefers newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) for telemetry but can accept gzip JSON bundles. I'll prep samples in ndjson and also provide a compressed archive for convenience.
2) PII redaction: for the sampling window we will redact or tokenise the following fields before export: user_email, ip_address (last octet masked), session_id. The redaction_guidelines.md will list exact regexes and a test vector. If LedgerOne prefers full IP anonymization instead of octet masking, let us know.
3) S3 paths: I will provide canonical prefixes and a short runbook (RB-LOG-EXPORT-17) for extraction and verification.

Timeline: I can produce the first Q1 sample and witness statement draft by Thu 3/17 EOD; full Q1+Q2 package by Tue 3/22. Weekly syncs: propose Fridays 10:00am PT for the next three weeks.

Alicia — is the proposed redaction approach acceptable for your auditors?

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redaction_guidelines.md
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@ledgerone.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@auditbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence request: witness statements + sampling window

Quick status and next steps:

- Confirmed owners: neha_kapoor (Audit logs), jordan_blake (KMS/key rotation), tessa_morgan (Data classification).
- Neha to deliver initial Q1 ndjson sample + witness draft 3/17 (received) and full Q1+Q2 package 3/22 (on schedule).
- Jordan to attach KMS key-rotation ledger and a short attestation note by 3/22.
- I've created the proof chronicle folder and provisioned read-only links for LedgerOne and AuditBridge: https://redwood-inference.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/caiq-proof-chronicle.
- DocuSign attestation: I will prepare a 1-page attestation per control owner and circulate for signature the week of 3/22.

Alicia / Tom: please confirm that ndjson + gzip JSON archives are acceptable and that the listed redaction approach meets your needs. If you need a sample verification checklist for each artifact (hashes, extraction steps, attestations) I can attach a short checklist template to the proof chronicle.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Trust Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: (see proof chronicle folder)
